entries.title: High-Throughput Webhook Ingestion Service
entries.content: Build an async webhook receiver capable of handling 5,000 requests/sec with idempotent delivery guarantees.

entries.title: Idempotency & Deduplication Store
entries.content: Use PostgreSQL 16 with an UNIQUE constraint on (provider_id, event_id) and transactional outbox table.

entries.title: HMAC Signature Verification Middleware
entries.content: Implemented constant-time HMAC-SHA256 verification and replay-window timestamp check in src/middleware/hmac.py.

entries.title: Implement Outbox Worker & Retry Backoff
entries.content: Create the background worker that polls pending outbox rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and exponential backoff.
